mentions.name: RGB digital sand timer
mentions.description: A physical RGB digital sand timer with customizable timing sequences, usable for techniques like the pomodoro technique. It has a working prototype, and the author is experimenting with interfaces (buttons plus an accelerometer, possibly a small smartphone app) for configuring the timing sequences.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently I'm working on an RGB digital sand timer with customizable timing sequences so that you can use it for things like the pomodoro technique - I have a working prototype and at the moment I'm experimenting with interfaces for setting the sequences.
